dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline along the posterior margin from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a broad pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree angular incline relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1:1 ratio between the visible base width and vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad convex curve characterizing the cranial-dorsal boundary.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the transition point between the melon and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform artificial cyan-teal emissive texture across the entire visible surface.
